item.title: feat(skills): reconcile learned skill collections (#121653)
item.summary: feat(skills): reconcile learned skill collections (#121653) Replace divergent per-skill curation with one daily isolated collection review that can consolidate, rewrite, create, and drop writable skills atomically. Autonomous auto mode remains automatic. Adds bounded review, transactional recovery, durable cadence, shared locking, and reuse-first /learn behavior. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
